text: Scope addition from the S0.9 review (s09-portability 6d7eaf3): S2.9 also wires the S0.9 Platform into the desktop runtime. StudioApplication constructs DesktopPlatform. StudioWindow.fxDialogs ImportSources/OpenProject use Platform.dialogs (chooseOpen/chooseDirectory). DesktopEffects.wallClock is replaced by Platform.scheduler/clock. StudioFonts.loadAll goes through Platform.fonts. RevealProject uses ExternalOpen. Acceptance: no remaining direct java.time/FileChooser/Clipboard use in the desktop runtime outside DesktopPlatform; PORTING.md Known gaps entry removed.
